title: Buona Run Config
description: Target configuration for buona run/detect (buona.json). Applies to whichever execution target directory is selected (workspace root or package directory).

system.description: Global build system for this target. Use "auto" for automatic detection or specify a system name.

commands.description: Per-command overrides. Keys are command names (e.g. "build", "test").

hooksDir.description: Directory to scan for convention-based hook scripts. Relative paths are resolved from the target directory containing this buona.json.

hooks.description: Explicit hook definitions. Keys are "pre<command>" or "post<command>". Values can be a build system name, a shell command string, or an argv array.

anyOf.description: A build system name (e.g. "cargo", "npm") or a shell command (e.g. "./scripts/gen.sh").

commandConfig.description: Override configuration for a specific command.

system.description: Override the build system for just this command.

exec.description: Full exec override: replaces the entire argv for this command.
